3.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
3.text: "Increased activity by the Bludish Freedom Front, for example, would be a most unwelcome distraction for Mr. Smolak."

4.speaker: Player_Romus
4.text: "So it's true that you've been providing aid to the BFF?"

5.speaker: Player_Romus
5.text: "What do you mean by 'activity'? I don't want any more innocents to be hurt."

6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "Cooperating with the Bluds? There's got to be another way."

7.speaker: Player_Romus
7.text: "Creating instability in the north of Wehlen would indeed divert his focus from Zille."

8.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
8.text: "I'm afraid the Bluds often have no choice but to go to extremes. We cannot control them, only provide them with the tools for liberation."

9.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
9.text: "The Bluds are engaged in a lengthy struggle against a regime that outnumbers and outguns them. We're interested in leveling that playing field."

10.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
10.text: "They have suffered under Wehlen's regime just as the people of Zille have. One need not agree with all of their aims to have sympathy with their cause."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "I'm not convinced. Do you have any other suggestions?"

13.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
13.text: "You wouldn't have to deal with any BFF leaders directly. Merely channel a small contribution through our existing avenues."

14.speaker: Player_Romus
14.text: "We're not like you. We don't meddle in other countries' internal disputes."

16.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
16.text: "Your enterprising new war councilor has submitted an inquiry to our defense department regarding our KA-74 rifles."

17.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
17.text: "Yet you're only in this predicament because your father begged Wehlen to meddle in Rizia's. Curious."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "You make a convincing case. I'm interested." [-1 Budget]

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "This sounds suspiciously like we'd be funding your goals, not ours."

20.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
20.text: "Frankly, Rizia stands to benefit more from a destabilized Wehlen than Rumburg does. For the moment."

21.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
21.text: "Marvelous. Would you like to hear my other proposal?"

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "Of course. I wouldn't let a member of my council go rogue like that."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "I don't remember. So many items pass my desk in a day."

25.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
25.text: "I agree. You should commend your councilor for her initiative."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "Absolutely not. Duchess Azaro is grasping beyond her station."

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "Their zealotry makes me uncomfortable. But the enemy of my enemy is my friend."

28.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
28.text: "Evil is in the eye of the beholder. There are those who have called me evil for maintaining Rumburg's monarchy at an age when global trends run to the contrary. You too, I suspect."

29.speaker: Player_Romus
29.text: "Are they currently planning anything? I've heard no news of them."

30.speaker: Narrator
30.text: Beatrice took a sip of tea with her little finger extended. She gave a satisfied nod, then continued.

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "Still, if President Smolak were to have even the slightest suspicion of ties between us and the BFF, our chances for a peaceful transfer of Zille would evaporate."

32.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
32.text: "I do have one more proposal for you."

33.speaker: Player_Romus
33.text: "Perhaps you can countenance unleashing such an evil. I cannot."

34.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
34.text: "The imprisonment of their leader Dewlan Arge put a damper on their operations."

35.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
35.text: "From what our inside sources tell us, they have been regrouping. Gathering ammunition and recruits until they are again strong enough to take on their oppressors."

37.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
37.text: "There are those who've called me a zealot for daring to unite the lands of Northern Merkopa. It is all in the eye of the beholder."

38.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
38.text: "We're already supplying your military with the latest models. But Ms. Azaro suggested that Rizia purchase a license to manufacture the weapons on its own soil."

39.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
39.text: "Did you approve this inquiry, Your Majesty?"

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "I truly appreciate your offer of help. But I have decided to deal with Wehlen on my own."

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "I'll go in on funding the BFF. That's all I'm prepared to do for now."

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "No, you should go visit with Vina. But I will go in on funding the BFF after all." [-1 Budget]

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: Beatrice gave me an appraising look.

44.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
44.text: "My, what a pleasant surprise. I'll see to it at once."

47.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
47.text: "I respect your wish to handle things your way. I do hope all goes well."

48.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
48.text: "I understand. We're playing a long game, but expect a return on the investment."

49.speaker: Player_Romus
49.text: "I did not. But it's not a bad idea."

51.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
51.text: "Well, you should commend your councilor for her initiative."

52.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
52.text: "We don't normally issue such licenses, but for Rizia, we might consider an exception."

53.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
53.text: "Well, you two have raised an interesting possibility."

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "I'm averse to the idea of manufacturing assault rifles. But such a license could prove useful."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "We need to be able to up our arms supply the moment disaster strikes. And this would save us the headache of gun shipping."

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "Forget that inquiry ever happened. I don't want Rizian factories making deadly weapons."

60.speaker: Player_Romus
60.text: "No. I'd rather keep purchasing weapons from Rumburg as usual."

61.speaker: Player_Romus
61.text: "I'll get back to you if and when we have the capability to make those rifles."

62.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
62.text: "Then we shall continue selling you those weapons as usual."

65.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
65.text: "Nobody *wants* to use KA-74s. But when the need arises, nothing else will do."

66.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
66.text: "Suit yourself. I'm only bringing this up because your staff asked about it."

68.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
68.text: "And family members help each other out. Almost unconditionally."

69.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
69.text: "See about acquiring facilities in which to make the weapons, and I'll see what I can do."

70.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
70.text: "Remember, Your Majesty, my sister may be gone, but I am still proud to call House Toras my family."

71.speaker: Narrator
71.text: She drew closer to me. Her emeralds glinted in the lamplight.
